tasks.title: Shooting
tasks.description: Eliminate enemy sprites with the shooting mechanic! Control movement and aim carefully.

requirements.title: Enemy appears 1
requirements.text: The enemy appears at the top of the stage.

requirements.title: Second and third enemy
requirements.text: Duplicate the enemy sprite and for each enemy set the movement speed and coordinate area where it appears.

requirements.title: Losing
requirements.text: For the "Rocket" sprite, describe the conditions under which a loss occurs.

requirements.title: Fire movement
requirements.text: Program the fire starting upon the click of the mouse button. The fire flies until it touches the edge or one of the enemies. When it touches something, it sends the message "hit."

requirements.title: Enemies react to fire hitting
requirements.text: The enemies receive the message "hit," and if they touch fire, they start again.

requirements.title: *Bonus: add a main enemy
requirements.text: Modify the game as you like. Add enemies and change their appearance. Add a main enemy.

requirements.title: *Bonus: The main enemy changes size
requirements.text: If you hit the main enemy, it gets smaller. If it is less than a certain value, you win.
